postgres_server.limitation: Runner does not read credential-bearing connection configuration or open a separate database session.

mcp_processes.limitation: Integration suites own MCP child processes; declared package versions and source bytes are fingerprinted instead.

cleanup_evidence.fixture_ownership: Each test suite owns its unique database, process, and temporary-root fixtures.
cleanup_evidence.limitation: The runner records suite exit codes and output but has no independent database/process/root cleanup oracle.
